name: ephe-motion-studio
description: Local motion films from HTML, CSS and JS sources: a timeline, captions, a brand kit and a render queue that cuts frames to MP4 on this machine.

commands.name: motion-new
commands.description: Create a motion project and write its first sources
commands.template: Create a motion project for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_create_project, then ephe_motion_write_source for the HTML, CSS and JS sources. Name the project id and the revision you wrote.

commands.name: motion-open
commands.description: Open a motion project and read its timeline
commands.template: Open the motion project for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_open_project, then ephe_motion_list_timeline and ephe_motion_inspect_project. Report the revision and the clip count.

commands.name: motion-import
commands.description: Import a local asset into a motion project
commands.template: Import an asset for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_import_asset with the local path, then ephe_motion_list_assets. Name the asset id and its path.

commands.name: motion-templates
commands.description: List the shipped motion source templates
commands.template: List the motion templates for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_inspect_project and name the template ids that fit; leave the project unwritten.

commands.name: motion-assets
commands.description: List the assets a motion project holds
commands.template: List the assets for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_list_assets and name each asset id, its path and its size.

commands.name: motion-render
commands.description: Render a motion project to MP4
commands.template: Render the motion project for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_render, then ephe_motion_wait_render with the render id. Name the MP4 path and its duration.

commands.name: motion-brand
commands.description: Apply a brand kit to a motion project
commands.template: Apply the brand kit for: {input}. Call ephe_motion_apply_brand with the colours, font and logo asset, then ephe_motion_inspect_project. Name the revision.

tools.name: ephe_motion_create_project
tools.description: Create a motion project: one JSON document with scenes, a timeline, captions and a brand kit, written under the plugin state root.

tools.name: ephe_motion_open_project
tools.description: Read one motion project and its current revision.

tools.name: ephe_motion_list_assets
tools.description: List the assets a motion project holds, with id, path, media type and size.

tools.name: ephe_motion_import_asset
tools.description: Copy one local asset into a motion project under its own asset id.

tools.name: ephe_motion_read_source
tools.description: Read one HTML, CSS or JS source of a motion project.

tools.name: ephe_motion_write_source
tools.description: Write one HTML, CSS or JS source of a motion project. expected_revision is a 64-hex conflict check: a stale revision is refused and nothing is written.

tools.name: ephe_motion_inspect_project
tools.description: Summarize a motion project: schema, revision, duration, clip count, caption count, assets and sources.

tools.name: ephe_motion_list_timeline
tools.description: List the clips and captions of a motion project in timeline order.

tools.name: ephe_motion_trim_clip
tools.description: Trim one clip to a new start and duration, under the revision conflict check.

tools.name: ephe_motion_reorder_clips
tools.description: Reorder the timeline by naming the clip ids in their new order, under the revision conflict check.

tools.name: ephe_motion_add_caption
tools.description: Add one caption to the timeline, under the revision conflict check.

tools.name: ephe_motion_apply_brand
tools.description: Apply a brand kit (name, colours, font, logo asset) to a motion project, under the revision conflict check.

tools.name: ephe_motion_render
tools.description: Render a motion project to MP4: the sources load in Chromium, frames are captured with Playwright, and ffmpeg cuts them to a video on this machine.

tools.name: ephe_motion_render_status
tools.description: Read the status of one render: pending, running, done, cancelled or failed, with the artifact path when it is done.

tools.name: ephe_motion_cancel_render
tools.description: Cancel one pending or running render. A render that already finished is left alone.

tools.name: ephe_motion_export_project
tools.description: Export a motion project as a ZIP of its JSON document, sources and assets, under the plugin state root or a folder the user names.

tools.name: ephe_motion_wait_render
tools.description: Wait for one render to finish, polling its status until it is done, cancelled or failed, or the timeout passes.

changelog: 1.0.0 - Ephe Motion Studio: a local motion project model with HTML, CSS and JS sources, a revision conflict check, captions, a brand kit and a Playwright plus ffmpeg render path.
